text: The land-change method was unable to evaluate the property due to insufficient evidence. The assessment status is "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE" because the necessary source coverage for this asset has not been prepared, and no observations were made. Specifically, the sources Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, and MGAP 2021 are not available for this property. Therefore, the method cannot establish whether tree-cover loss occurred, did not occur, or determine any compliance findings.
